description: `roas` gives per-campaign spend, installs (install_at in the range, split exact / weak / modelled, fraud-flagged kept out of CPI), trials, paying users, cohort revenue (paid in the range by installs from the range), CPI, CAC and ROAS = net cohort revenue ÷ spend — the same numbers as get_attribution_report kpis grouped by campaign. `blended` is the whole app by payment date and `unattributed` the part of it with no source; always keep attributed and blended figures apart. Money is per currency (no conversion). Default range: the last 28 days in the app's time zone. `spend` gives raw daily ad-spend rows. `links` lists this app's tracking links.
name: get_acquisition_report
title: Get paid acquisition performance
